Tenants, host aliases and public verification keys; host lookup, the aggregate revision and the paged active-tenant enumeration only through three SECURITY DEFINER functions; provisioning pins their search_path and grants EXECUTE to the resolving identities. No clinical data; never part of a tenant artifact, export, erase or restore.

CREATE TABLE tenant_registry_keys (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenant_registry (tenant_id), purpose text NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('access','management')), kid text NOT NULL CHECK (kid ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$'), public_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (public_key ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}=$'), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, purpose, kid))

CREATE TABLE tenant_registry_clock (singleton boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK (singleton), revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 0))

CREATE FUNCTION tenant_registry_touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$ BEGIN UPDATE tenant_registry_clock SET revision = revision + 1; RETURN NULL; END $fn$
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION tenant_registry_touch() FROM PUBLIC
CREATE TRIGGER tenant_registry_revision AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON tenant_registry FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION tenant_registry_touch()
CREATE TRIGGER tenant_registry_hosts_revision AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON tenant_registry_hosts FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION tenant_registry_touch()
CREATE TRIGGER tenant_registry_keys_revision AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON tenant_registry_keys FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION tenant_registry_touch()

CREATE FUNCTION tenant_registry_lookup(lookup_host text, lookup_kind text) RETURNS TABLE (tenant_id uuid, state text) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog SET app.current_tenant_id = '' AS $fn$ DECLARE t uuid; BEGIN IF lookup_host IS NULL OR lookup_kind IS NULL OR length(lookup_host) > 259 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TENANT_REGISTRY_LOOKUP_REFUSED'; END IF; SELECT h.tenant_id INTO t FROM tenant_registry_hosts h WHERE h.host = lookup_host AND h.kind = lookup_kind; IF t IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF; PERFORM set_config('app.current_tenant_id', t::text, true); RETURN QUERY SELECT r.tenant_id, r.state FROM tenant_registry r WHERE r.tenant_id = t; END $fn$
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION tenant_registry_lookup(text, text) FROM PUBLIC

CREATE FUNCTION tenant_registry_revision() RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$ BEGIN RETURN (SELECT c.revision FROM tenant_registry_clock c WHERE c.singleton); END $fn$
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION tenant_registry_revision() FROM PUBLIC

CREATE FUNCTION tenant_registry_tenants(after_tenant uuid, page_size integer) RETURNS TABLE (tenant_id uuid) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog SET app.current_tenant_id = '' AS $fn$ DECLARE t uuid; n integer := 0; BEGIN IF page_size IS NULL OR page_size < 1 OR page_size > 10000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TENANT_REGISTRY_PAGE_REFUSED'; END IF; FOR t IN SELECT DISTINCT h.tenant_id FROM tenant_registry_hosts h WHERE after_tenant IS NULL OR h.tenant_id > after_tenant ORDER BY 1 LOOP PERFORM set_config('app.current_tenant_id', t::text, true); IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_registry r WHERE r.tenant_id = t AND r.state = 'active') THEN tenant_id := t; RETURN NEXT; n := n + 1; EXIT WHEN n >= page_size; END IF; END LOOP; RETURN; END $fn$
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION tenant_registry_tenants(uuid, integer) FROM PUBLIC
